reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004E8C60 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/define/004E8C60-DefineSound.cpp at sha256 ece8f43bcbdd6135ff3766cde112d0df082e27cb267ba3c7a5f6829b33930ccb (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t DefineSound(long param_1, long param_2, long param_3, long param_4, long param_5, long param_6, long param_7, int32_t param_8, void* param_9, float param_10);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: DefineSound
retail_function.signature: int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0, long double arg2 @ st1, long double arg3 @ st2, long double arg4 @ st3, long double arg5 @ st4, long double arg6 @ st5, long double arg7 @ st6, int32_t arg8, void* arg9, float arg10)
retail_function.summary: Single block 0x4E8C60-0x4E8DB3: consume seven x87 values (fstp qword [esp+0xF4], st0), call SoundSys_PlaySoundSample_13, resolve 0x20-byte strings through Sys_ResolveSymbol_23, call Sound_LoadSample (0x4E75E0), set Profile values, and copy the 24-byte record to the result buffer. The QVM frame is read from [E+0x10].

candidate_function.signature: int32_t DefineSound(long param_1, long param_2, long param_3, long param_4, long param_5, long param_6, long param_7, int32_t param_8, void* param_9, float param_10);
candidate_function.summary: Define_Sound(long double, x7, int arg8, void* arg9, float arg10) reproduces the call order and constants but delivers the seven x87 values and the QVM frame as ordinary cdecl stack parameters.

divergences: x87 argument delivery: st0-st6 in retail vs cdecl long-double stack parameters.
QVM frame slot: retail [E+0x10]; the candidate's arg8/arg9/arg10 occupy [E+4]+.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004E8C60 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/define/004E8C60-DefineSound.cpp (sha256 ece8f43bcbdd6135ff3766cde112d0df082e27cb267ba3c7a5f6829b33930ccb). Single block 0x4E8C60-0x4E8DB3: consume seven x87 values (fstp qword [esp+0xF4], st0), call SoundSys_PlaySoundSample_13, resolve 0x20-byte strings through Sys_ResolveSymbol_23, call Sound_LoadSample (0x4E75E0), set Profile values, and copy the 24-byte record to the result buffer. The QVM frame is read from [E+0x10]. Candidate: Define_Sound(long double, x7, int arg8, void* arg9, float arg10) reproduces the call order and constants but delivers the seven x87 values and the QVM frame as ordinary cdecl stack parameters.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail consumes st0-st6 through `fstp qword [esp+0xF4]` etc. and reads the QVM frame from [E+0x10]; BN models `int32_t(long double @ st0 ... long double @ st6, int32_t arg8, void* arg9, float arg10)`. The candidate declares the same long-double list but as cdecl parameters, which the compiler places on the stack, and its arg8/arg9/arg10 land at [E+4].. instead of the retail slots.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Seven floating-point arguments must arrive on the x87 stack and the frame at [E+0x10]; the candidate's parameters are stack words. The x87 stack depth and the QVM frame slot are both lost.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and radare2 agree on 1 blocks / 0 edges (similarity 1.000); angr CFGFast recovers 18 blocks with has_unresolved_jumps=false. The angr block-count difference is a granularity artifact of CFGFast splitting at call returns / rep movsd; the BN and radare2 block and edge tables are identical.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: The call sequence matches: SoundSys_PlaySoundSample_13, Sys_ResolveSymbol_23, Sound_LoadSample, Profile_LoadValue/Profile_ValueSet (all at the same addresses).

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: 0x20 resolve widths, the 0x180/0x159 profile strides and the f32 constants match.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: The 24-byte record build and copy match the retail stack writes.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns the result-buffer word; the candidate's declared first parameter is at [E+4] instead of the retail result slot, so the returned pointer differs.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The seven x87 inputs are consumed from st0-st6 in retail; the candidate's long double parameters are passed in memory, so the floating-point stack contract is not preserved.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0, long double arg2 @ st1, long double arg3 @ st2, long double arg4 @ st3, long double arg5 @ st4, long double arg6 @ st5, long double arg7 @ st6, int32_t arg8, void* arg9, float arg10)" at 0x004E8C60; radare2 recovers "fcn.004e8c60 (int32_t arg_15ch, int32_t arg_198h, int32_t arg_168h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x004E8C60 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t DefineSound(long param_1, long param_2, long param_3, long param_4, long param_5, long param_6, long param_7, int32_t param_8, void* param_9, float param_10);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The candidate defines Define_Sound; the catalog spelling DefineSound differs only in the underscore.
